run_vhacd_convex_decomposition: run V-HACD convex decomposition on a 3D OBJ mesh file using pybullet
connect_pybullet_direct: connect to pybullet in DIRECT non-graphical mode for headless processing
set_pybullet_search_path: set an additional search path for pybullet data files using setAdditionalSearchPath
get_pybullet_data_path: get the pybullet data directory path using pybullet_data.getDataPath
decompose_obj_mesh: decompose an OBJ mesh into convex hulls and output a new OBJ file with vhacd
